data_description.house_device_energy_sensors: Energy sensors (kWh) for standalone devices — EV chargers, pool pumps, water heaters. Used in energy attribution.

zone_setup.title: Zone Setup
zone_setup.description: Zones group rooms together for coordinated automation (e.g., 'Upstairs', 'Kids Area', 'Outdoor'). Rooms in a zone can share settings and appear in zone-level sensors.

data_description.zone_name: A short, unique name for this zone (e.g., 'Upstairs', 'Guest Suite')
data_description.zone_description: Optional description of what this zone covers
data_description.zone_rooms: Select existing rooms to include in this zone

room_setup.title: 🚪 Room Setup
room_setup.description: Configure the basic information for this room. The room type affects default timeout settings.

data_description.room_name: A friendly name for this room (e.g., 'Master Bedroom')
data_description.room_type: Type affects default timeout (bedrooms: 15 min, closets: 2 min)
data_description.area_id: Link to a Home Assistant area for device discovery
data_description.zone: Assign to a zone for grouped automation. Select existing or type new.
data_description.shared_space: Enable scheduled auto-off for common areas (living room, hallway)
data_description.shared_space_auto_off_hour: Hour (0-23) to turn off forgotten devices. 23 = 11 PM
data_description.shared_space_warning: Flash lights 5 minutes before auto-off as a warning
data_description.occupancy_timeout: Seconds after last motion before room is marked vacant
data_description.occupancy_debounce: Milliseconds to wait before confirming occupancy after motion is detected. Lower = faster response, higher = fewer false triggers. 0 for instant response with pre-filtered sensors (Screek, ESPHome LD2410).

sensors.title: 📡 Presence & Environmental Sensors
sensors.description: Select sensors for occupancy detection and environmental monitoring. At least one occupancy sensor (motion, presence, or combined) is required.

data_description.motion_sensors: PIR sensors that detect movement (triggers occupancy)
data_description.presence_sensors: mmWave/radar sensors that detect presence without movement
data_description.scanner_areas: Only needed for sparse scanner homes. Select areas where BLE scanners are located that should map to this room. Leave empty if this room has its own scanner.
data_description.disable_camera_presence: Skip camera-based presence detection for this room. Use for rooms with chronic camera person-classifier false positives (TV reflections, sun-glare hallways). The room's other sensors (mmWave, PIR, BLE) continue to contribute.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature for climate automation and alerts
data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity for fan control and comfort alerts
data_description.illuminance_sensor: Light level (lux) for 'turn on if dark' automation
data_description.door_sensor: Door open/closed sensor for security alerts
data_description.door_type: Interior doors vs. egress (exterior) doors have different alert thresholds
data_description.window_sensor: Window open/closed sensor for security alerts
data_description.is_egress_window: When ON (default), leaving this window open for the configured Egress Pause Threshold (~3 min) pauses the HVAC zone that serves this room (hvac_mode: off). Designed for kid-forgetfulness — small ventilation windows that open frequently but shouldn't stop HVAC should be set OFF.

devices.title: Devices to Automate
devices.description: Select the lights, fans, covers, and switches that should be automated based on room occupancy. Night light details and cover settings will be configured in follow-up steps if applicable.

data_description.lights: Lights to control on entry/exit (auto-detected from area if available)
data_description.light_capabilities: What your lights support: basic on/off, brightness, or full color (auto-detected)
data_description.night_lights: Select lights from above list to use as night lights during sleep hours
data_description.fans: Ceiling fans, floor fans, or switches for temperature-based cooling (fan.* or switch.*)
data_description.humidity_fans: Exhaust fans (fan.* or switch.* for RF/outlet-controlled fans)
data_description.auto_switches: Devices (lights, fans, switches, input_booleans) that turn on with occupancy and off when vacant
data_description.manual_switches: Devices (lights, fans, switches, input_booleans) that only turn off when vacant (not auto-on)
data_description.auto_devices: Devices (lights, fans, switches, input_booleans) that turn on with occupancy and off when vacant
data_description.manual_devices: Devices (lights, fans, switches, input_booleans) that only turn off when vacant (not auto-on)

night_light_detail.title: Night Light Settings
night_light_detail.description: Configure brightness and color temperature for night lights during sleep and daytime hours.

data_description.night_light_sleep_brightness: Brightness for night lights during sleep hours (dim for safety)
data_description.night_light_sleep_color: Color temperature during sleep hours (warm/red tones recommended)
data_description.night_light_day_brightness: Brightness for night lights outside sleep hours
data_description.night_light_day_color: Color temperature outside sleep hours (cool/white tones recommended)

cover_behavior.title: Cover Automation
cover_behavior.description: Configure how window covers/blinds respond to occupancy and time-of-day.

data_description.entry_cover_action: When to open covers on room entry
data_description.exit_cover_action: When to close covers on room exit
data_description.open_timing_mode: Control when covers are allowed to open
data_description.sunrise_offset: Minutes before/after sunrise for sun-based timing
data_description.timed_close_enabled: Automatically close covers at a specific time
data_description.sunset_offset: Minutes before/after sunset for sun-based timing
data_description.cover_hvac_managed: When ON, the HVAC coordinator may close these covers during peak afternoon solar hours to reduce cooling load. Turn OFF to keep this room's covers exempt from HVAC management (e.g. master bedroom for naps, kid's room with light-sensitive sleep).

automation_behavior.title: Automation Behavior
automation_behavior.description: Configure how lights respond to occupancy changes.

data_description.entry_light_action: What to do with lights when someone enters the room
data_description.exit_light_action: What to do with lights when the room becomes vacant
data_description.illuminance_dark_threshold: Lux level below which the room is considered 'dark'
data_description.light_brightness_pct: Brightness level when turning lights on (1-100%)
data_description.light_transition_seconds_on: Fade-in time when turning lights on
data_description.light_transition_seconds_off: Fade-out time when turning lights off

climate.title: Climate & Fans
climate.description: Configure fans first (HVAC-managed, comfort, humidity/exhaust), then the climate backstop at the bottom (comfort range + thermostat fallback).

data_description.hvac_coordination_enabled: When ON, comfort fans are managed by the HVAC coordinator instead of room-level rules.
data_description.fan_control_enabled: Automatically control comfort/ceiling fans based on temperature (speed thresholds in next step).
data_description.humidity_fan_control_enabled: Master switch for humidity/exhaust automation. When OFF, URA does not actuate the humidity fans at all.
data_description.wet_room: When ON, this room is treated as a wet room: enables humidity spike + post-vacancy runtime by default and exempts the exhaust from sleep-policy force-off.
data_description.humidity_fan_spike_enabled: Adaptive baseline detection — fires the fan when humidity rises sharply above its running baseline (catches showers before the absolute threshold).
data_description.humidity_fan_presence_runtime_enabled: After vacancy, keep the exhaust running for a usage-proportional period to finish venting.
data_description.humidity_fan_presence_runtime_per_min_s: Additional seconds of post-vacancy runtime per minute of prior occupancy.
data_description.humidity_fan_presence_runtime_cap_s: Hard cap on the post-vacancy runtime; must be ≤ Humidity Fan Max Runtime.
data_description.fan_temp_threshold: Temperature above which comfort fans turn on.
data_description.humidity_fan_threshold: Humidity % above which exhaust fans turn on (absolute threshold; OR-companion to spike detection).
data_description.humidity_fan_timeout: Minimum continuous runtime before the fan is allowed to turn off after humidity drops below threshold. Prevents short-cycling.
data_description.humidity_fan_max_runtime: Maximum continuous humidity-fan runtime. Forces off if humidity stays elevated longer than this — protects against stuck humidity sensors and runaway runs.

data_description.humidity_fan_spike_delta_pct: How many percentage points above the running baseline counts as a spike (e.g. 10 = fire when humidity rises 10pp above its baseline).
data_description.humidity_fan_spike_ema_alpha_s: Time-constant of the EMA (exponential moving average) baseline, in seconds. Larger = slower baseline that ignores brief blips; smaller = faster baseline that adapts to room changes.
data_description.humidity_fan_spike_baseline_mode: How the baseline is computed: EMA (adaptive average) tracks the slow drift; Window minimum uses the lowest value over a recent window.

data_description.target_temp_heat: Lower bound of the comfortable temperature range. Used by the comfort/efficiency score sensors.
data_description.target_temp_cool: Upper bound of the comfortable temperature range. Used by the comfort/efficiency score sensors.
data_description.climate_entity: Optional fallback thermostat for zone-thermostat resolution when the zone has no explicit thermostat set.

fan_speeds.title: Fan Speed Thresholds
fan_speeds.description: Configure temperature thresholds for each fan speed level.

sleep_protection.title: Sleep Protection
sleep_protection.description: Prevent automation from disturbing sleep during nighttime hours.

data_description.sleep_protection_enabled: Block most automation during sleep hours
data_description.sleep_start_hour: Hour when sleep mode starts (0-23, e.g., 22 = 10 PM)
data_description.sleep_end_hour: Hour when sleep mode ends (0-23, e.g., 7 = 7 AM)
data_description.sleep_bypass_motion_count: Motion events needed to override sleep mode
data_description.sleep_block_covers: Prevent covers from opening during sleep hours
data_description.fan_sleep_policy: How fans behave during sleep hours: off, reduced speed, or normal

energy.description: Track energy usage and costs for devices in this room.

data_description.electricity_rate: Per-room fallback used only when the Energy Coordinator is not configured. With the Energy Coordinator active, room costs follow the live TOU rate and this value is ignored.
data_description.notify_daily_energy_summary: Send daily energy usage summary notification

data_description.alert_lights: Lights to flash/change color for visual alerts
data_description.alert_light_color: Color to use for alert indication

zone_hvac.title: 🌡️ Zone HVAC
zone_hvac.description: Select the thermostat that controls this zone. If not set, falls back to the first room's thermostat. The AC Load Sensor below is used by the AC Ramp-Down feature (v4.5.11) to detect when this zone keeps burning energy past setpoint.

data.hvac_ac_ramp_zone_enabled: AC Ramp-Down enabled for this zone

data_description.zone_thermostat: Climate entity to control for this zone
data_description.hvac_ac_load_sensor: Sensor that measures this AC unit's draw (Span panel circuit, Emporia Vue, etc.). Power (kW) is preferred. Leave empty to disable the ramp-down feature for this zone.
data_description.hvac_ac_ramp_zone_enabled: When OFF, this zone is skipped by the AC ramp-down feature even when the master switch is ON. Useful for AC units on circuits shared with other large loads (dryer, oven) that would cause false positives.

zone_energy.title: ⚡ Zone Energy Sensors
zone_energy.description: Configure power and energy sensors for zone-level loads (HVAC circuits, subpanel meters). These track energy not attributable to individual rooms.

data_description.zone_power_sensors: Power sensors for zone-level loads like HVAC circuits (watts)

zone_persons.description: Select people who primarily live in zone '{zone_name}'. When they arrive home, HVAC will pre-condition this zone before they reach it.

data_description.zone_persons: Select one or more person entities. Their zone will start pre-cooling or pre-heating when their phone crosses the geofence on arrival.

zone_cameras.title: Zone Cameras
zone_cameras.description: Select person detection cameras in zone '{zone_name}'. Face recognition from these cameras enables instant pre-arrival conditioning — no 15-minute BLE wait required.

data_description.zone_cameras: Camera person-detection sensors (Frigate person_occupancy, UniFi person_detected). Cameras are also auto-discovered from room area assignments.

zone_dynamic_preset.description: Configure per-zone Dynamic Preset temperature ranges for zone '{zone_name}'. Enable DPM for this zone and set target setpoint ranges for each outdoor condition bucket.

data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_enabled: When enabled, DPM adjusts this zone's thermostat setpoints based on outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_offset: Additional °F offset applied on top of bucket adjustments (0-3°F, step 0.5). Useful for zones that consistently run warm/cool.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_reset_offset_guest: When Guest Mode is active, reset this zone's offset to 0 to maintain comfortable temperatures for guests.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_sleep_enabled: Enable separate temperature ranges for sleep preset. When off, sleep uses the same ranges as home preset.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_cool_home_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in cool outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_cool_home_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in cool outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_mild_home_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in mild outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_mild_home_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in mild outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_hot_home_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in hot outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_hot_home_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in hot outdoor conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_extreme_home_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in extreme heat conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_extreme_home_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for home preset in extreme heat conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_cool_sleep_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in cool conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_cool_sleep_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in cool conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_mild_sleep_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in mild conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_mild_sleep_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in mild conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_hot_sleep_low: Minimum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in hot conditions.
data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_hot_sleep_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in hot conditions.

data_description.zone_dynamic_preset_extreme_sleep_high: Maximum cooling setpoint (°F) for sleep preset in extreme conditions.

person_tracking.title: 👥 Person Tracking
person_tracking.description: Configure which people to track and how transitions are detected.

data_description.tracked_persons: Select person entities to track room-to-room movement
data_description.person_data_retention: How long to keep transition history (0 = forever)
data_description.transition_detection_window: Seconds to wait before confirming a room transition

camera_census.title: 📷 Camera Census
camera_census.description: Set up cameras for person counting. Pick any camera entity — person detection sensors are found automatically. Works with UniFi Protect, Frigate, Reolink, and Dahua.

data_description.census_cross_validation: When you run multiple camera platforms (e.g., Frigate and UniFi Protect), person counts are compared between them for higher accuracy. Turn this off if you only use one camera platform or prefer simpler, single-source counting.
data_description.camera_person_entities: Select cameras inside your home. Each camera is automatically mapped to a room using its area assignment in Home Assistant. Works with UniFi Protect, Frigate, Reolink, and Dahua.
data_description.egress_cameras: Cameras at your exterior doors (front door, back door, garage). Used to track who enters and leaves — not used for room occupancy. Deliveries and visitors at the door won't trigger room automation.
data_description.perimeter_cameras: Cameras covering your yard, driveway, or fence line. Used to count people on your property who are outside the house.
data_description.face_recognition_enabled: When enabled, face recognition data from camera events is used to confirm the identity of persons during transit validation. Requires a camera integration that provides face recognition. Defaults to off — path validation works without it.
data_description.enhanced_census: Enable event-driven sensor fusion with hold/decay, WiFi guest VLAN detection, and Frigate face recognition differentiation. Separates 'people seen' from 'people recognized' for better guest detection.
data_description.guest_vlan_ssid: SSID of your guest WiFi network (e.g., 'Revel'). Phones connected to this SSID are counted as guests. Leave blank to disable WiFi guest detection.
data_description.census_hold_interior: How long (in minutes) to hold the peak person count for indoor cameras before starting decay. Prevents count drops when people move between rooms or sit in camera blind spots. Default: 15 minutes.
data_description.census_hold_exterior: How long (in minutes) to hold the peak person count for outdoor/perimeter cameras before dropping. Shorter than interior because outdoor detections are more transient. Default: 5 minutes.

perimeter_alerting.title: 🚨 Perimeter Alerting
perimeter_alerting.description: Send notifications when a person is detected on your perimeter cameras during quiet hours. Requires at least one perimeter camera to be configured in Camera Census.

data_description.perimeter_alert_hours_start: Alert monitoring starts at this hour (0–23). Default: 11 PM (23). Overnight ranges are supported — e.g. start 23, end 5 alerts from 11 PM to 5 AM.
data_description.perimeter_alert_hours_end: Alert monitoring ends at this hour (0–23). Wraps overnight when end is before start. Default: 5 AM.
data_description.perimeter_alert_notify_service: Notification service to call when a person is detected on your perimeter (e.g., notify.mobile_app_john). Leave blank to disable notifications.
data_description.perimeter_alert_notify_target: Notification target (optional — leave blank to use the service default).

domain_coordinators.title: 🤖 Domain Coordinators
domain_coordinators.description: Enable the domain coordinator system for whole-house intelligence. When enabled, a Coordinator Manager device is created and house-level coordination becomes available. Individual coordinators (Presence, Safety, Security, Energy, HVAC, Comfort) are configured in later updates.

data_description.domain_coordinators_enabled: Turn on to activate the domain coordinator framework. Creates the Coordinator Manager device, house state tracking, and decision logging. Requires integration reload.

coordinator_presence.title: 👥 Presence Settings
coordinator_presence.description: Configure the Presence Coordinator. Sleep hours determine when the house transitions to sleep/waking states. Geofence trackers detect arrivals and departures.

data_description.sleep_start_hour: Hour (0–23) when the house enters sleep mode. Default: 23 (11 PM).
data_description.sleep_end_hour: Hour (0–23) when the house exits sleep mode. Default: 6 (6 AM).
data_description.geofence_entities: Device tracker entities used for geofence-based arrival/departure detection. Select person device trackers that report home/not_home zones.
data_description.guest_mode_persistence_seconds: How long an unidentified person must persist before the house enters Guest mode. Filters transient ID failures (face DB miss, BLE coverage gap). Set to 0 to disable persistence (instant trigger). Default: 300s (5 min).
data_description.guest_mode_require_confidence: Minimum census confidence required to trigger Guest mode. 'medium' refuses to fire when cameras disagree or no camera data. 'high' requires both camera platforms agree. Default: medium.
data_description.fan_recheck_enabled: Master kill-switch for the fan-noise Mode-2 BLE-gated fan-pause+recheck. Default OFF; flip ON after live validation. Timing knobs live under the collapsed Advanced section.

fan_recheck_advanced.name: Fan Recheck Timing (Advanced — rarely change)
fan_recheck_advanced.description: Timing knobs for the fan-noise Mode-2 recheck state machine. Defaults are tuned for typical mmwave + ceiling-fan setups; only adjust if you understand the trade-offs.

data_description.fan_recheck_arm_delay_s: Delay between trigger eligibility and arming the recheck. Filters quick false-positives. Default: 60s.
data_description.fan_recheck_spindown_s: How long airflow takes to stop after the fan is paused. mmWave is ignored during this period. Default: 30s.
data_description.fan_recheck_window_s: Observation window after spindown. If mmWave drops while the fan is paused, the room vacates. Default: 60s.
data_description.fan_recheck_cooldown_s: Wait time between rechecks per room before another can fire. Default: 1800s (30 min).
data_description.fan_recheck_max_per_hour: Hard cap on how many rechecks a single room can run per hour. 0 disables the cap. Default: 2.
data_description.fan_recheck_hvac_suppress_s: How long HVAC fan-routing stays suppressed for this room after a recheck pauses the fan, so heat/cool doesn't immediately re-energize it. Default: 600s (10 min).
data_description.fan_recheck_mmwave_history_ticks: Number of consecutive presence ticks that must be mmWave-only (no motion/occupancy/camera) before a recheck is eligible. Default: 3.

coordinator_safety.title: 🛡️ Safety Monitoring
coordinator_safety.description: Configure the Safety Coordinator. The water shutoff valve is activated automatically on water leak detection. Emergency lights are set to 100% brightness during evacuations.

data.global_aq_sensors: Global Air Quality Sensors (CO, CO₂, VOC)

data_description.water_shutoff_valve: Optional valve entity to close automatically on water leak detection (HIGH severity or above). Leave empty if no shutoff valve is installed — you can add one later.
data_description.emergency_light_entities: Lights to set to 100% brightness during fire/CO evacuations. Select lights along evacuation routes (hallways, stairways, exits).
data_description.global_smoke_sensors: Smoke/gas detectors not assigned to any URA room. These are monitored globally by the Safety Coordinator.
data_description.global_leak_sensors: Water leak sensors not assigned to any URA room (e.g., utility chase, water main).
data_description.global_aq_sensors: Air quality sensors (CO, CO₂, VOC) not assigned to any URA room.
data_description.global_temp_sensors: Temperature sensors not assigned to any URA room (e.g., attic, crawl space).
data_description.global_humidity_sensors: Humidity sensors not assigned to any URA room.

coordinator_security.title: 🔒 Security
coordinator_security.description: Configure the Security Coordinator. Manages armed states, entry monitoring, lock control, and security camera triggers. All devices are manually configured — no auto-discovery.

data_description.security_lock_entities: Door locks to control during security events and periodic lock checks. Must be manually selected.
data_description.security_garage_entities: Garage doors and automated egress points. Treated as locks for periodic check and lockdown.
data_description.security_entry_sensors: Door/window binary sensors to monitor for entry events.
data_description.security_light_entities: Lights to activate at full brightness during security alerts. Must be manually selected.
data_description.security_camera_entities: Cameras for recording triggers during security events. Only used when recording is enabled.
data_description.security_camera_recording: Enable camera recording triggers during alerts. Disabled by default — cameras are assumed to be on continuous recording.
data_description.security_camera_record_duration: Duration in seconds for camera recording triggers.
data_description.security_alarm_panel: Optional alarm panel entity for bidirectional armed state sync. Leave empty to manage armed state independently.
data_description.security_auto_follow: Automatically set armed state based on house state (away → armed_away, home → armed_home). Off by default.
data_description.security_lock_check_interval: Minutes between periodic lock compliance checks. Runs regardless of armed state.

coordinator_energy.title: ⚡ Energy Coordinator
coordinator_energy.description: Configure the Energy Coordinator. Manages battery strategy, pool/EV optimization, TOU-aware cost tracking, and daily forecasting via Enphase Envoy and Solcast.

data.energy_envoy_entity: Envoy Sensor (pick any — serial auto-derives all energy entities)
data.inclement_power_threat_events: Event types that can hold the battery
data.inclement_warn_min_severity: Minimum severity that can hold the battery
data.inclement_grid_precharge_on_hold: Charge from grid to fill the battery during holds
data.garage_a_self_modulates: Garage A self-modulates (URA re-pauses every cycle)
data.garage_b_self_modulates: Garage B self-modulates (URA re-pauses every cycle)

data_description.energy_reserve_soc: Minimum battery reserve percentage. Battery won't discharge below this level during normal operation. Default: 20%.
data_description.energy_bill_cycle_day: Day of the month your PEC billing cycle starts. Used for cost tracking and bill prediction. Default: 23.
data_description.energy_decision_interval: Minutes between energy decision cycles. Controls how often battery strategy, pool speed, and EV charging are evaluated. Default: 5.
data_description.energy_weather_entity: Primary weather entity for temperature-based consumption prediction and dynamic preset classification. Inherits from house settings if not set here.
data_description.energy_weather_fallback_1: Secondary weather provider used when the primary is stale or unavailable. If both primary and secondary diverge beyond the threshold, the median value is used. Leave empty to disable secondary provider.
data_description.energy_weather_fallback_2: Tertiary weather provider (third in the ranked list). Used only when secondary is also unavailable. Helps compute divergence across 3 sources for higher-confidence apparent-temp readings. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.weather_staleness_max_hours: Maximum age (in hours) of a weather provider's last update before it is considered stale and skipped. Default: 3 hours.
data_description.weather_divergence_threshold_f: If two healthy providers disagree on today's high by more than this many °F, the binary_sensor.ura_weather_divergence turns ON and a WARNING is logged. The median value is used as the authoritative reading. Default: 5°F.
data_description.inclement_nws_alerts_entity: The Home Assistant sensor that exposes National Weather Service alerts (e.g. sensor.nws_alerts_…). Leave blank to fall back to weather-condition cross-checks only.
data_description.inclement_power_threat_events: One per line. Case-insensitive substring match against the NWS Event name (so 'Severe Thunderstorm' matches both 'Severe Thunderstorm Warning' AND 'Severe Thunderstorm Watch'). This is the FIRST gate — any alert whose Event name does NOT match an entry here is informational only and will not hold the battery, regardless of how severe it sounds. Fire-weather alerts (Red Flag Warning, Fire Weather Watch) are notice-only by default; ADD 'Red Flag' or 'Fire Weather' here to make them hold-eligible. Flood alerts are absent by default for this elevated property; ADD 'Flood' if your location is power-vulnerable to flooding.
data_description.inclement_warn_min_severity: Secondary noise filter applied AFTER the Event-type gate. Choose the lowest NWS Severity value that should still produce a hold. 'Extreme' — only catastrophic events; 'Severe' (recommended) — Severe + Extreme; 'Moderate' — Moderate + Severe + Extreme; 'Minor' — any non-Unknown severity. NOTE: this filter never overrides the Event-type gate — a non-power-threat event is always informational regardless of severity.
data_description.inclement_grid_precharge_on_hold: When ON, a warning-tier hold will pull from grid during off_peak hours to top up the battery to ~90% before the storm. When OFF, the battery is held at whatever level the sun/arbitrage put it at — no expensive grid energy is used. URA defaults OFF (solar-first philosophy).
data_description.energy_solcast_today_entity: Sensor providing today's total solar forecast in kWh. Used for solar day classification. Default: Solcast forecast_today sensor.
data_description.energy_solcast_tomorrow_entity: Sensor providing tomorrow's total solar forecast in kWh. Used for off-peak drain targets and arbitrage decisions. Default: Solcast forecast_tomorrow sensor.
data_description.energy_solcast_remaining_entity: Sensor providing remaining solar forecast for today in kWh. Used for excess solar EV charging decisions. Default: Solcast forecast_remaining_today sensor.
data_description.energy_evse_a_entity: Power sensor for Garage A EV charger (e.g., Emporia WiFi). Used to track EV charging load.
data_description.energy_evse_b_entity: Power sensor for Garage B EV charger. Used to track EV charging load.
data_description.energy_evse_a_span_breaker: SPAN panel breaker switch that pauses/resumes Garage A EV charging. Override this if you renamed the breaker in the SPAN app and the default no longer resolves. Leave blank to use the built-in default (switch.span_panel_car_charger_breaker).
data_description.energy_evse_b_span_breaker: SPAN panel breaker switch that pauses/resumes Garage B EV charging. Override this if you renamed the breaker in the SPAN app and the default no longer resolves. Leave blank to use the built-in default (switch.span_panel_garage_b_evse_breaker).
data_description.energy_l1_charger_entities: Smart plug switches used as L1 chargers. Binary charge status derived from switch state (no power sensor needed).
data_description.energy_solar_classification_mode: Automatic uses monthly percentile thresholds from your production history. Custom lets you set fixed kWh thresholds year-round.
data_description.energy_solar_threshold_excellent: Custom mode: forecast above this = excellent day. Only used when Solar Day Classification is set to Custom.
data_description.energy_solar_threshold_good: Custom mode: forecast above this = good day. Only used when Solar Day Classification is set to Custom.
data_description.energy_solar_threshold_moderate: Custom mode: forecast above this = moderate day. Only used when Solar Day Classification is set to Custom.
data_description.energy_solar_threshold_poor: Custom mode: forecast above this = poor day. Below this = very poor. Only used when Solar Day Classification is set to Custom.
data_description.energy_load_shedding_enabled: Enable automatic load shedding during peak import events. Progressively sheds non-essential loads when grid import exceeds threshold.
data_description.energy_load_shedding_mode: Fixed uses a static kW threshold. Auto learns your baseline and triggers on anomalies.
data_description.energy_load_shedding_threshold_kw: Grid import power above which load shedding activates. Only used in Fixed mode.
data_description.energy_load_shedding_sustained_minutes: Minutes that import must exceed the threshold before load shedding begins. Prevents triggering on brief spikes.
data_description.energy_constraint_coast_offset: Temperature offset for HVAC coast mode during load shedding. Cooling setpoint raised by this amount. Default: 2.0.
data_description.energy_constraint_precool_offset: Temperature offset for pre-cooling before anticipated peak. Cooling setpoint lowered by this amount. Default: -2.0.
data_description.energy_constraint_preheat_offset: Temperature offset for pre-heating before anticipated peak. Heating setpoint raised by this amount. Default: 2.0.
data_description.energy_constraint_shed_offset: Temperature offset for aggressive HVAC shedding. Cooling setpoint raised by this amount during active shedding. Default: 4.0.
data_description.energy_preheat_temp_threshold: Outside temperature below which pre-heat mode activates instead of pre-cool. Default: 45.
data_description.energy_offpeak_drain_excellent: Off-peak SOC drain target when tomorrow's solar is excellent. Battery drains stored solar to this level overnight while importing cheap off-peak grid. Default: 10%.
data_description.energy_offpeak_drain_good: Off-peak SOC drain target when tomorrow's solar is good. Default: 15%.
data_description.energy_offpeak_drain_moderate: Off-peak SOC drain target when tomorrow's solar is moderate. Default: 20%.
data_description.energy_offpeak_drain_poor: Off-peak SOC drain target when tomorrow's solar is poor. Arbitrage catches worst case. Default: 30%.
data_description.energy_arbitrage_enabled: Enable overnight grid charging when the next high-rate window's day is forecast poor/very_poor. Charges at off-peak rate to avoid importing at higher mid-peak/peak rates. v4.5.0: gate is forecast-class only — no SOC trigger.
data_description.energy_peak_buffer_target: SOC target for arbitrage charging. Charging stops when battery reaches this level; HOLD locks the buffer here until the high-rate window begins. v4.5.0: replaces 'Arbitrage SOC Target'. Default: 80%.
data_description.energy_solcast_day_3_entity: Solcast forecast for D+2 (day-after-tomorrow). Used by the multi-day horizon toggle to broaden the arbitrage gate when D+2 is poor.
data_description.energy_multi_day_horizon_enabled: When ON, the arbitrage gate also fires when day-after-tomorrow (D+2) is forecast poor/very_poor. Drain-target fallback path picks the more conservative of D+1 and D+2 when arbitrage is disabled. Default: OFF (calibrate first).
data_description.energy_excess_solar_enabled: Master toggle for both the SOC-based pause-until rule and the SOC-based turn-on rule. Off-peak TOU pause and battery-drain protection run independently.
data_description.energy_excess_solar_soc: When battery is ABOVE this percentage AND solar surplus is available, URA turns EV+L1 charging ON even during off-peak pause. Default 95%. Range 80-100%. Pair with the Pause EV Until Battery SOC threshold (default 80).
data_description.energy_excess_solar_kwh: Remaining solar forecast (kWh) above which excess solar triggers EV charging. Default: 5.0 kWh.
data_description.energy_fill_priority_soc: When battery is BELOW this percentage and solar forecast is healthy, URA pauses EV+L1 charging so the battery fills first. Default 80%. Range 50-95%. Pair with the Resume EV at Battery SOC threshold (default 95) for an asymmetric dead band.
data_description.garage_a_self_modulates: Check this for smart EVSEs/plugs with native solar or schedule modes (Emporia, Tesla Wall Connector). URA re-pauses every cycle; use the EVSE Force-Charge button to override. Leave unchecked for any other hardware — URA detects real user toggles and backs off for 1 hour.
data_description.garage_b_self_modulates: Check this for smart EVSEs/plugs with native solar or schedule modes (Emporia, Tesla Wall Connector). URA re-pauses every cycle; use the EVSE Force-Charge button to override. Leave unchecked for any other hardware — URA detects real user toggles and backs off for 1 hour.
data_description.energy_grid_import_cap_enabled: Pause EV charging when total grid import exceeds the cap. Resumes when import drops below cap minus 1 kW hysteresis.
data_description.energy_grid_import_cap_kw: Maximum grid import in kW before pausing EV charging. Default: 8 kW.
data_description.energy_arbitrage_grid_import_guard_enabl: Enable a software cap on how much the BATTERY may import from grid while arbitrage grid-charging. Default OFF — the battery hardware already curtails to the breaker. Only enable to throttle BELOW the hardware limit. When enabled you MUST enter a kW value below — there is no default threshold.
data_description.energy_arbitrage_grid_import_guard_kw: Software cap on how much the BATTERY may import from grid while arbitrage grid-charging. Default OFF. When enabled you MUST enter your DER breaker's continuous rating (amps × 240 × 0.8 ÷ 1000) — there is no default threshold.
data_description.energy_ev_battery_drain_soc: When the home battery is actively discharging below this SOC AND EV+L1 is charging, URA pauses to protect battery reserve. Default 50% (deep floor behind Pause EV Until Battery SOC). Range 5-95%. See README_v4.7.6.1 for the asymmetric-defaults rationale.
data_description.energy_utility_meter_entity: Utility company net energy meter (e.g., SmartHub). Used for bill prediction calibration and divergence tracking against Envoy-derived consumption.
data_description.occupancy_weighted_energy: Use Bayesian occupancy predictions to weight energy consumption estimates by room occupancy patterns. Requires B1/B2 Bayesian data. Default: OFF.
data_description.energy_circuit_extra_entities: Additional power sensors to monitor as circuits (Emporia channels, Shelly EMs, balance sensors). Merged with auto-discovered circuits.
data_description.energy_circuit_exclude_entities: Circuit sensors to exclude from monitoring. Use this to remove SPAN sub-panel feed circuits that overlap with Emporia channel monitoring, preventing double-counting.
data_description.energy_circuit_autodiscover_span: Automatically discover SPAN panel circuit sensors. Disable if you don't have SPAN panels. Default: ON.
data_description.energy_generator_entity: Generator status sensor entity. Replaces default Generac entity.
data_description.energy_grid_import_entity: Direct grid import power sensor (e.g., Emporia mains_from_grid). When set, used as primary source for cost tracking instead of Envoy net power.
data_description.energy_grid_export_entity: Direct grid export power sensor (e.g., Emporia mains_to_grid). When set, used as primary source for export tracking.

inclement_advanced.name: Inclement Weather — Advanced
inclement_advanced.description: Tuning knobs for the inclement-weather battery hold. Defaults are recommended.

data_description.inclement_partial_hold_reserve_floor: When URA decides to partially hold (e.g. low-certainty watch during peak with sun ahead), how much battery to keep in reserve. 50% (default) — preserves a robust overnight backup while still allowing some peak savings. Set lower for more peak savings, higher for more backup.
data_description.inclement_recoverable_surplus_margin_pct: How much projected solar SURPLUS (net of house load) must EXCEED what a partial hold would let URA discharge, before that discharge counts as 'recoverable' by sun before nightfall. Default 5% SOC. URA reuses the attainability surplus projection (which already nets house load via a 0.5 capture factor), then requires this extra margin so a cloudy / high-load day doesn't falsely read as recoverable. This is a margin over a load-net surplus, NOT a raw kWh threshold. Only consulted during mid_peak / peak rungs — off_peak holds without consulting recoverability.
data_description.inclement_condition_corroboration_mode: 'any' — over-eager (one provider stormy holds); 'majority' — balanced (recommended); 'unanimous' — under-eager (one stale provider blocks).

error.guard_kw_required_when_enabled: The Arbitrage Grid-Charge Import Guard is ON but no kW value was entered. Enter your DER breaker's continuous rating (amps × 240 × 0.8 ÷ 1000) — there is no default threshold.

coordinator_hvac_settings.title: 🌡️ HVAC Coordinator Tuning
coordinator_hvac_settings.description: Manages zone presets, override detection, fan control, cover management, and pre-conditioning.

data_description.hvac_max_sleep_offset: How much to relax the cooling setpoint during sleep. Higher = more energy savings, less cooling at night.
data_description.hvac_compromise_minutes: After detecting a manual thermostat change, how long to hold a compromise temperature before reverting.
data_description.hvac_ac_reset_timeout: Minutes a zone must be stuck cooling/heating past its setpoint before cycling the thermostat off to reset.
data_description.hvac_fan_activation_delta: How far above the cooling setpoint the temperature must rise before turning on fans.
data_description.hvac_fan_hysteresis: How far the temperature must drop below the fan activation threshold before turning fans off.
data_description.hvac_fan_min_runtime: Minimum time fans stay on once activated, to prevent short cycling.
data_description.hvac_cover_entities: Cover entities for solar gain management. If empty, covers are auto-discovered from room entries.
data_description.hvac_fan_control_enabled: Temperature-based ceiling fan management. When enabled, fans activate in occupied rooms when temperature exceeds the thermostat setpoint. Disable to let external automations manage fans.
data_description.hvac_arrester_enabled: Detect and revert manual thermostat overrides that conflict with URA presets.
data_description.hvac_ac_reset_enabled: Cycle the thermostat off briefly when a stuck cooling/heating cycle is detected. Disable if AC reset is causing issues. The thermostat has its own compressor protection.
data_description.zone_vacancy_sweep_enabled: Turn off lights and fans in zones after they become vacant. Runs after the vacancy grace period expires. Disable to keep lights/fans running when zones empty.
data_description.pre_arrival_sources: Which detection methods trigger zone pre-conditioning when a person arrives home. Geofence uses phone GPS; BLE uses Bluetooth proximity beacons; Camera Face uses Frigate/UniFi face recognition for instant confirmation.
data_description.hvac_zone_entry_dwell: Minutes a zone must be occupied before switching from away to home preset. Prevents HVAC from conditioning zones when someone just walks through briefly. Only applies when the house is already occupied — has no effect on arrival from away. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 3.
data_description.hvac_vacancy_grace_minutes: Minutes a zone must stay empty before HVAC backs off to the Away preset. Lower = AC retreats faster after you leave. Default: 15.
data_description.hvac_vacancy_grace_constrained: Shorter vacancy delay used while the house is energy-coasting (constrained). Must be ≤ the normal Zone Vacancy Delay. Default: 5.
data_description.hvac_max_occupancy_hours: If a zone reads continuously occupied this long, HVAC treats the presence signal as stuck and stops trusting it. Default: 8 (hours).
data_description.hvac_occupied_cover_close_delta: When a room is occupied, HVAC only closes its covers for solar-gain reduction if the room temp is at least this many °F above the zone's cooling setpoint. Lower = more aggressive (closes covers sooner when occupied), higher = more conservative (lets occupied rooms get warmer before closing). Default: 2.0°F.
data_description.hvac_solar_gain_cover_enabled: Master toggle for the entire solar-gain cover management feature. When OFF, HVAC does not close or open any covers regardless of per-room settings. Per-room cover automation (timed open/close, exit close) is unaffected.
data_description.hvac_cover_close_temp: Outdoor temperature at which HVAC starts closing covers for solar-gain reduction (during the solar window hours). Texas summer ≥85°F is typical; humid climates may want lower. Default: 85°F.
data_description.hvac_cover_open_temp: Outdoor temperature at which HVAC reopens previously-closed covers (hysteresis with Cover Close Temp). Must be at least 3°F below Cover Close Temp to prevent flapping. Default: 80°F.
data_description.hvac_cover_override_hours: How long HVAC respects a manual cover position change before resuming automation. After this many hours, HVAC may reapply solar-gain logic to the cover. Default: 2 hours.
data_description.hvac_solar_bank_floor: Coolest setpoint solar banking will drive HVAC zones to. Banking applies a -3°F offset to the room's normal cool target, but never below this absolute floor. Default: 72°F.
data_description.hvac_cover_solar_start_hour: Hour HVAC starts watching for solar-gain conditions. Set earlier (e.g. 11) for east-facing homes; later for west-only orientations. Default: 13 (1 PM).
data_description.hvac_cover_solar_end_hour: Hour HVAC stops solar-gain cover management and reopens any HVAC-closed covers. Pair with sunset in your area. Default: 18 (6 PM).
data_description.hvac_solar_bank_soc_min: Battery state-of-charge above which surplus solar is dumped into thermal banking instead of grid export. Lower = more aggressive banking; higher = more battery headroom for evening. Default: 95%.
data_description.hvac_solar_bank_enabled: Initial state for Solar HVAC Banking. When ON (default), HVAC pre-cools all zones during 10am–2pm whenever the battery is full and surplus solar would otherwise export to grid. Turn OFF if banking is over-cooling the house on good-solar days. NOTE: this field only seeds the initial state after install. At runtime the 'Solar HVAC Banking' switch on the Energy Coordinator device card is authoritative (its last-toggled value persists across restarts via RestoreEntity and OVERRIDES this field).
data_description.hvac_pre_conditioning_enabled: Initial state for the HVAC Predictive Conditioning master gate. When ON (default), HVAC may run weather pre-cool, solar banking, pre-arrival, and pre-heat. When OFF, ALL pre-conditioning branches short-circuit and any in-flight pre-conditioned zones release to their baseline range within one cycle. NOTE 1: this field only seeds the initial state after install. At runtime the 'HVAC Predictive Conditioning' switch on the HVAC Coordinator device card is authoritative (its last-toggled value persists across restarts and OVERRIDES this field). NOTE 2: this switch suppresses PREDICTIVE pre-conditioning only. The Energy Coordinator's REACTIVE TOU pre_cool / pre_heat constraint (driven by the live rate schedule) is a separate mechanism and is NOT suppressed by this switch.
data_description.hvac_precool_forecast_high: When tomorrow's forecast high exceeds this, HVAC pre-cools occupied zones before peak hours. Lower = more pre-cooling; higher = pre-cool only on extreme days. Default: 90°F.
data_description.hvac_preheat_forecast_low: When outdoor temp drops below this in winter, HVAC pre-heats occupied zones before off-peak ends. Higher = more pre-heating; lower = pre-heat only on coldest days. Default: 35°F.

hvac_dynamic_preset.title: 🌡️ Dynamic Preset Auto-Adjust
hvac_dynamic_preset.description: When outside feels cooler than the last two weeks, DPM relaxes the upper end of Home and Sleep cool ranges (e.g. 70-75 → 70-76). When outside feels hotter, DPM tightens (70-74). Two knobs control how much. DPM is off in winter and stays off until 7 days of forecast data have been collected.

data.dpm_cool_day_relax_f: Relax cool ceiling on cool-feeling days (°F)
data.dpm_hot_day_tighten_f: Tighten cool ceiling on hot-feeling days (°F)

data_description.dynamic_preset_enabled: Master toggle for the Dynamic Preset feature. When off, all zones fall back to the seasonal baseline setpoints.
data_description.dpm_cool_day_relax_f: How many °F to raise the Home/Sleep cool ceiling on days the forecast feels cooler than the last 2 weeks. 0 = off. Default 1°F (e.g., 70-75 becomes 70-76).
data_description.dpm_hot_day_tighten_f: How many °F to lower the Home/Sleep cool ceiling on days the forecast feels hotter than the last 2 weeks. 0 = off. Default 1°F (e.g., 70-75 becomes 70-74).
data_description.dpm_relax_ceiling_mode: When the forecast is above this temperature, the system won't widen cool ranges even if today is cooler than recent days. Auto picks a sensible value for your climate.
data_description.dynamic_preset_dwell_minutes: Minutes a cool/hot/typical-day condition must persist before adjustments apply. Prevents rapid cycling. Range: 15-240 min. Default: 60.
data_description.dynamic_preset_hysteresis_f: Temperature band around the adjustment threshold before switching states. Prevents flapping. Range: 0.5-5.0°F. Default: 2.0.

hvac_baseline_presets.title: 📅 Baseline Presets (Seasonal)
hvac_baseline_presets.description: Edit the house-wide preset temperature ranges per season. These are the baseline setpoints that every zone uses unless Dynamic Preset is configured per-zone. Cooling setpoint must be at least 3°F above heating setpoint. To restore factory defaults, check 'Reset all to defaults' and save.

data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_home_cool: Summer (Jun–Sep) Home preset cooling target. Default: 77°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_home_heat: Summer Home preset heating floor. Default: 70°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_sleep_cool: Summer Sleep preset cooling target. Default: 76°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_sleep_heat: Summer Sleep preset heating floor. Default: 70°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_away_cool: Summer Away preset cooling target. Default: 82°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_away_heat: Summer Away preset heating floor. Default: 60°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_vacation_cool: Summer Vacation preset cooling target. Default: 85°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_summer_vacation_heat: Summer Vacation preset heating floor. Default: 58°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_home_cool: Shoulder (Mar–May, Oct–Nov) Home preset cooling target. Default: 74°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_home_heat: Shoulder Home preset heating floor. Default: 70°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_sleep_cool: Shoulder Sleep preset cooling target. Default: 73°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_sleep_heat: Shoulder Sleep preset heating floor. Default: 68°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_away_cool: Shoulder Away preset cooling target. Default: 80°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_away_heat: Shoulder Away preset heating floor. Default: 62°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_vacation_cool: Shoulder Vacation preset cooling target. Default: 82°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_shoulder_vacation_heat: Shoulder Vacation preset heating floor. Default: 58°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_home_cool: Winter (Dec–Feb) Home preset cooling target. Default: 72°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_home_heat: Winter Home preset heating floor. Default: 70°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_sleep_cool: Winter Sleep preset cooling target. Default: 70°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_sleep_heat: Winter Sleep preset heating floor. Default: 68°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_away_cool: Winter Away preset cooling target. Default: 78°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_away_heat: Winter Away preset heating floor. Default: 60°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_vacation_cool: Winter Vacation preset cooling target. Default: 80°F.
data_description.hvac_baseline_winter_vacation_heat: Winter Vacation preset heating floor. Default: 58°F.
data_description._reset_all: Check and save to restore all 24 baseline setpoints to factory defaults. This action requires confirmation on the next screen.

coordinator_music_following.title: 🎵 Music Following
coordinator_music_following.description: Configure the Music Following Coordinator. Controls how music transfers when a person moves between rooms. Adjust timing parameters to tune transfer behavior for your speaker setup.

data_description.mf_cooldown_seconds: Minimum seconds between transfers to the same target room per person. Prevents rapid repeated transfers. Default: 8.
data_description.mf_ping_pong_window: Seconds within which an A-to-B-to-A transition is suppressed as ping-pong. Default: 60.
data_description.mf_verify_delay: Seconds to wait after transfer before verifying the target speaker is playing. Default: 2.
data_description.mf_unjoin_delay: Seconds to wait before unjoining the source speaker from a group after transfer. Default: 5.
data_description.mf_position_offset: Seconds to add to the media position when resuming on the target speaker, to account for transfer delay. Default: 3.
data_description.mf_min_confidence: Minimum transition confidence (0.1-1.0) required to trigger a music transfer. Lower values transfer more aggressively. Default: 0.6.
data_description.mf_high_confidence_distance: Maximum BLE distance (feet) from closest area scanner to trigger music transfer. Tighter than person tracking default (10ft) to avoid transfers on BLE bleed-through from adjacent rooms. Default: 8.

coordinator_optimization.title: 🤖 URA Optimizer
coordinator_optimization.description: How autonomous should the Optimizer be? Start in Shadow mode and raise only after you trust its findings. The Kill Switch on the Optimizer device pauses everything instantly.

data_description.optimizer_autonomy_level: How far the Optimizer can act on its own findings. Default: Shadow mode (logs what it WOULD do, never acts). Raise one step at a time, watch the activity log, escalate when you trust it.
data_description.optimizer_kill_switch: When ON, the Optimizer is clamped to Observe-only. Survives restart. Use this when you need a fast brake.
data_description.optimizer_confidence_gate: Findings below this confidence stay advisory regardless of autonomy level. Higher = more cautious. Default: 0.70.
data_description.optimizer_rate_cap_per_hour: Hard ceiling on autonomous actions per rolling hour. Anything past the cap falls back to Shadow until the window resets. Default: 12.
data_description.optimizer_quiet_hours_source: When 'Use Notification Manager quiet hours', the Optimizer clamps to Shadow during quiet hours so it never wakes you. 'None' ignores quiet hours.
data_description.optimizer_safety_deny_entities: Entities the Optimizer must never actuate (any tier). Use for safety-critical switches and locks.
data_description.optimizer_llm_task_entity: AI Task entity used for primary reasoning. Routes through Home Assistant's `ai_task` integration (Claude / OpenAI / Ollama / Google).
data_description.optimizer_llm_triage_entity: Optional cheaper backend used to triage which findings deserve a primary call. Leave empty to skip triage.
data_description.optimizer_llm_system_prompt: Free-form prompt prepended to every LLM call. Use for house-specific guardrails (e.g. 'never touch the nursery').
data_description.optimizer_llm_max_invocations_per_24h: Hard daily ceiling on premium LLM calls. Survives restart (seeded from the DB). Default: 24.

ev_tou_management.name: EVSE TOU Management
ev_tou_management.description: URA owns EVSE TOU behavior in BOTH directions: (a) pauses ALL EVSE-class devices (L2 wall connectors and L1 plug-style chargers) during peak and mid-peak TOU periods, AND (b) proactively ensures EVSEs are turned ON during off-peak unless a battery-protection guard (drain, fill-priority, grid-cap, arbitrage) is active. Turning this toggle OFF disables BOTH the peak-pause AND the off-peak ensure-on. Each device's `self_modulates` flag (in its config step) governs whether URA enforces idempotent re-pause or honors external HA automation.

hvac_ac_nudge.name: AC Nudge
hvac_ac_nudge.description: Soft-nudge detection for AC overshoot. When ON, an overshoot + sustained kWh-rate triggers a small temporary bump of the cool setpoint to coax the compressor to ramp down. Independent of AC Reset — turning Nudge OFF skips soft-nudge detection but AC Reset (if also ON) can still be invoked by direct triggers.

hvac_egress_window_pause.name: Egress Window Pause
hvac_egress_window_pause.description: When ON (default), leaving an egress window open past the Egress Pause Threshold pauses that room's HVAC zone (hvac_mode: off). Designed for kid-forgetfulness — keeps the compressor from running against an open window. Resumes after all egress windows have been closed for the Egress Resume Delay. Manual override during pause engages a 1-hour cooldown.

hvac_egress_threshold_min.name: Egress Pause Threshold
hvac_egress_threshold_min.description: Minutes an egress window must stay open before its HVAC zone pauses. Default 3 — short enough to catch a forgotten-open door, long enough to avoid pausing on a quick walk-through.

hvac_egress_resume_delay_min.name: Egress Resume Delay
hvac_egress_resume_delay_min.description: Minutes ALL egress windows in a zone must stay closed before URA restores the saved HVAC mode + preset. Default 1 — keeps the compressor from short-cycling if the door is bumped back open.

hvac_force_ac_reset.name: Force AC Reset
hvac_force_ac_reset.description: Manually trigger a hard AC reset for this zone. Requires AC Reset switch ON. Subject to daily cap and minimum interval gates. Use when soft-nudge auto-detection is disabled and you want to manually clear a stuck AC cycle.

optimizer_confirm_escalation.name: Confirm Escalation
optimizer_confirm_escalation.description: Commit a staged Optimizer autonomy escalation. Only available when the Autonomy Level select shows a 'Pending — ...' state.

optimizer_cancel_escalation.name: Cancel Escalation
optimizer_cancel_escalation.description: Drop a staged Optimizer autonomy escalation. Returns the level to its previously-committed rung.

optimizer_reset_settings.name: Reset Optimizer Settings
optimizer_reset_settings.description: Strip every Optimizer config knob (autonomy level, confidence gate, rate cap, quiet-hours source, deny-list, LLM settings) back to defaults. The Kill Switch is preserved — release it manually if you need to.

optimizer_run_cycle_now.name: Run Cycle Now
optimizer_run_cycle_now.description: Trigger an Optimizer cycle immediately instead of waiting for the next 5-min interval. Debounced to one press per 30s. Unavailable while the Kill Switch is engaged.
